title: VooPoo PnP X Replacement Coils - 5 Pack
description: The Voopoo PnP X Coils represent the latest innovation in vaping technology from Voopoo. These coils are compatible with a wide variety of Voopoo tanks and vape kits, and they come in several resistances to cater to a broad spectrum of vaping styles. Whether you prefer the intense flavour of MTL vaping or the rich, cloud-filled experience of DTL, these coils have you covered. One of the key features of the PnP X Coils is their famous Plug-n-Play design, making coil replacement effortless and convenient. Simply pull out the old coil and replace it with a new one. The coils also feature a patented 4-Layer Leakproof Design, ensuring a mess-free vaping experience. The mesh build of the coils provides an evenly distributed heating design, enhancing the flavour and vapour production of your e-liquids. Additionally, the thermo-stable cotton in these coils ensures incredibly accurate and delicious flavour delivery. Available in resistances of 0.15, 0.2, 0.3, 0.45, 0.6, 0.8 and 1.0 ohms, the PnP X Coils are sold in packs of five, providing you with plenty of options to customize your vaping experience. 0.15ohm - (60-80W) DTL Coil and suited for high VG e-liquids 0.2ohm - (40-60W) DTL Mesh Coil and suited for high VG e-liquids 0.3ohm - (32-40W) RDL/MTL Mesh Coil and suited for Nic Salt or high VG e-liquids 0.45ohm - (26-32W) RDL/MTL and suited for Nic Salt or high VG e-Liquid 0.8ohm - (12 - 15W) MTL Coil and Suited For High PG or 50/50 Freebase E-Liquid 0.6ohm - (18-23W) RDL/MTL Coil and suited for freebase and nicotine salts 1.0ohm - (10-13W) MTL Coil and Suited For High PG or 50/50 Freebase E-Liquid Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
